description: Read a VIA store card by its slug: a product co-created by members of a Back Room, with its price, the co-creators (name, share, payout wallet, ERC-8004 id), and how to buy it (the seller MCP buy_product tool over the x402 door). Returns not_found for unknown slugs.

slug.description: The store slug from a shared link, e.g. app.getvia.xyz/store/<slug>.

name: get_store_card
